title: Jenna Ortega Bares it All in Plunging Neckline Dress for New Photoshoot - NewsBreak
text:
By Evolve Editors ,
27 minutes ago Photo Credit: Warner Bros. Pictures Jenna Ortega made waves in a daring new photoshoot, stepping out in a plunging neckline dress that left little to the imagination. The actress shared the striking look on social media, giving fans a glimpse behind the scenes of her latest campaign.
Here’s what we know about her outfit, the creative team behind the shoot, and the reactions it sparked online.
Jenna Ortega stuns in glittery black dress for new photoshoot Jenna Ortega stars in new Dior photos, wearing a glittery black dress for the Rouge Dior On Stage campaign. Dior Beauty recently named her the face of its lipstick line, featuring shades Confident Nude, Redwood Star, and Iconic Rose.
Dior Beauty shared behind-the-scenes clips on Instagram, highlighting Ortega applying lipstick. She wore tailored pieces, including a blazer with a 1920s-inspired cut.
Ortega appears on set and during touch-ups in a black sequined, open-back dress. The shoot highlights red-carpet glamour with Dior’s Rouge Dior On Stage lipsticks. Dior describes the collection as offering “high shine and high glamour” with long-lasting pigment and hydration. Ortega called Redwood Star her favorite shade, describing it as a “brownish red” suited for everyday wear.
Speaking about her connection to Dior, Ortega recalled her earliest memory of visiting the brand’s storefront on El Paseo in the Coachella Valley. She said she was “mesmerised” by its design and by the customers’ excitement.
She also praised Dior’s balance of elegance and sensitivity, noting that the brand helps emphasize natural features. For the campaign shoot, Ortega said, “I wore an outfit that had a very 1920s feel to it that reminded me of Cabaret,” and added that she enjoyed the playful atmosphere on set. (via Garzia )
When asked about parallels between the campaign and her career, Ortega explained, “I do play unconventional characters—more so recently—and that’s really important to me.” She also pointed to her challenging roles, including Wednesday Addams and her performance in The Fallout, noting the responsibility in portraying complex characters.
In her interview, Ortega emphasized how makeup influences her mindset: “It’s immensely important for me, and especially when I do these big events or red carpets. You do need that boost of confidence; something that makes you feel a little bit stronger than yourself.”
Originally reported by Vritti Johar on Mandatory.com .
